title: Overdrive plan event
description: A plan event (spec §12.2, ADR 0035): a fact that tells the coach agent the plan may need rebuilding. The service only detects and queues events; no algorithm in the service moves a workout. kind is missed (a planned day ended with no matching activity), moved (the rider moved a planned session to another day in intervals.icu), deleted (the rider deleted a planned session there), variant (the easier variant of a session was ridden) or illness and travel (the rider declared them: POST /v1/plan-events). day is the rider's local day the event is about: the planned day for missed, moved (the day it was planned for) and deleted, and the day it was declared for illness and travel. workoutId is the planned workout (icu-123) the event is about, null exactly for illness and travel. detail holds what the kind knows: missed {name, plannedSeconds, plannedLoad}, moved {name, from, to}, deleted {name}, variant {name, rideId}, illness and travel {until} with until a date or null when no end was given. status is open until the coach agent resolves the event (resolve_plan_event), then resolved, with resolvedAt, a resolutionNote (what changed and why, in the agent's words, which the rider is sent in Telegram) and dropped (true when the session was dropped and not rescheduled: a valid outcome). While open, resolvedAt, resolutionNote and dropped are null. Rules a schema cannot state, checked by every implementation: day is a real calendar date; createdAt and resolvedAt are real UTC instants and resolvedAt is not before createdAt; workoutId is null exactly for kind illness and travel; for those kinds detail.until is null or a real date not before day; status open goes with null resolvedAt, resolutionNote and dropped, and resolved with all three set.
